name: elterngeld-help
description: Elterngeld (German parental allowance): amounts, deadlines, eligibility and month plans, in English or German.

interface.longDescription:
How much Elterngeld will you get, and when do you need to apply? Elterngeld Help answers your questions right in the chat, in English or German.

What you can ask:
• How much will I get? Your monthly Basiselterngeld and ElterngeldPlus, worked out with the same calculator as elterngeldhelp.com. If something that changes the amount is missing, the assistant asks you first.
• Can I get Elterngeld? For example with a residence permit, as a freelancer or with a high income.
• When do I have to apply? The latest date before you start losing months.
• How do we split the months? A plan for one or both parents, also with part-time work.
• Anything else about the rules, answered from reviewed help articles with links to the law.

When you are ready to apply, the assistant walks you through the steps and documents and links to elterngeldhelp.com, where you can prepare your application.

No login. You never need to share your name, address, tax ID or bank details, and Elterngeld Help does not store your answers.

All amounts are estimates. Your Elterngeldstelle sets the final amount. Elterngeld Help is independent and not affiliated with any government agency.
capabilities: Check the latest date to apply without losing months
Plan and check the months for one or both parents
Answer Elterngeld questions from reviewed articles with the law text

positive.description: Full estimate with every input given
positive.prompt: How much Elterngeld will I get? Baby due 15 March 2027, employed, €4,000 gross a month, tax class 4, no church tax, statutory insurance, no older children, no twins, single parent, nothing special in the year before, taxable income under €175,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns €1,640 Basiselterngeld and €820 ElterngeldPlus per month and shows the result card. The answer mentions the latest date to apply (14 July 2027) and calls the amounts estimates.

positive.description: Estimate with missing inputs asks first
positive.prompt: How much Elterngeld will I get? €4,000 gross, tax class 4, baby due March 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: No amount yet. The tool returns the open questions (older children, twins, income limit, church tax, health insurance, special months before the birth) and the assistant asks them, then calls the tool again.

positive.description: Rule question answered from reviewed articles
positive.prompt: Can I work part-time while receiving ElterngeldPlus?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the 32-hour weekly limit and how income during Elterngeld reduces the amount, with links to the Elterngeld Help articles and § 4a BEEG.

positive.description: Deadline for a baby already born
positive.prompt: Our baby was born on 20 June 2026. Is it too late to apply for Elterngeld?
positive.expected_behavior: Latest date without losing months was 19 October 2026. If applying now, one month is already lost; apply as soon as possible.

positive.description: How to apply and which documents
positive.prompt: How do I apply for Elterngeld and which documents do I need?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the steps, the documents and where to submit from the reviewed articles, and ends with a link to Elterngeld Help.
